lines: There are only five kinds of people playing GTA 6 right now.
Stops at every red light, uses the indicator, pays for every car.
And still gets run off the road in the first five minutes.
They've spent three hours taking sunset pictures on the beach.
Skips every cutscene, rushes every mission,
then asks everyone what the story was actually about.
Five wanted stars before the tutorial has even finished.
Every side job, every collectable, every hidden corner of the map.
It's four in the morning, and they're nowhere near done.
So be honest, which one are you?
Comment your number, and tag the friend who's number two!
